# bcdec

Single-header BC1–BC7 block decoder, `bcdec.h` v0.985, unmodified. Written by Sergii Kudlai. Used by `dm/gfx/tex/bc_dec.c` to expand Switch BC textures on GPUs that cannot sample them (an iPad mini 6, and any iPhone or iPad older than A17 Pro / M1).

License: MIT or the Unlicense, at the end of `bcdec.h`.
